body: If closure is incomplete its complement is an unhit blocker; an unhit blocker cannot create a first member. A unary12-cycle needs one seed, while four AND triads need eight and have81 minimum sets. Empty prerequisites and absent production rules have distinct effects. Exhaustive enumeration costs2^K. The four-triad finite-p slope8-8p/(3-2p) and rare success probability expose bias and sample cost; correlated/nonuniform seeds or changing downstream/reporting laws invalidate the assay.
